records.text: On October 4th, aircraft N582MM flew from Atlanta to Fort Huachuca, landed at 9:33 a.m., remained all day, and left at 4:39 p.m. for Kalispell.
records.speaker: Baron Coleman

appearances.snippet: This is Fort Huachuca. ... Atlanta to Fort Huachuca. ... It lands at 9.33 a.m. and it's there all day. It does not leave until 4.39 p.m. ... The new plane went to Fort Huachuca on October 4th and then went to Kalispell.

verification.notes: Live searches and accessible FAA and flight-tracker pages identified N582MM but did not expose the October 4 historical legs or times. Search results only repeated the podcast account, so the Atlanta-Fort Huachuca-Kalispell itinerary could not be independently verified.

records.text: On October 5th, a private plane flew from Kalispell to Bozeman, where a security team gathered before going to Fairy Lake the next day.
records.speaker: Baron Coleman

appearances.snippet: There was a flight from Kalispell to Bozeman. Bozeman is where the guys met up to go to Ferry Lake the following day. ... There was a flight, a private plane flight that went from Kalispell to Bozeman the next day. ... That's the day when everybody showed up and they had their security team retreat or something. I don't know what it was.

verification.notes: Live searches found no independently accessible flight record for the October 5 Kalispell-to-Bozeman leg and no authoritative record tying passengers to a security gathering or a Fairy Lake trip. Public results repeated the podcast theory.
